title: Government Strengthens SMILE-Beggary Rehabilitation Framework
summary: The Government of India has placed the SMILE-Beggary scheme under a wider rehabilitation framework for persons engaged in begging. The scheme was launched on 23 October 2023 and is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerme...

blocks.content: The Government of India has placed the SMILE-Beggary scheme under a wider rehabilitation framework for persons engaged in begging. The scheme was launched on 23 October 2023 and is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment .

items: SMILE is an acronym for Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise.
Anganwadi Centres function under the Integrated Child Development Services framework in India.
The Child Welfare Committee is a statutory body under the Juvenile Justice framework.
The SMILE-Beggary National Portal is used for monitoring shelter homes, rehabilitation centres, and fund utilisation.
